name: MolCrafts native toolchain
description: C/C++ build toolchain for Atomiverse and the compiled half of molnex / molrs-cxxapi: a modern CMake (>=4, Ubuntu ships 3.x), Ninja, clang tooling, ccache and Doxygen.

cmakeVersion.description: CMake release to install from the official Kitware binary tarball. molnex's build-system.requires pins 'cmake>=4', which no LTS distro package satisfies.

installClangTools.description: Install clang, clangd, clang-format, clang-tidy and lld.

installDoxygen.description: Install Doxygen and Graphviz (Atomiverse's docs target calls find_package(Doxygen)).

installCcache.description: Install ccache to keep C++20/CUDA rebuilds cheap.
